# President Rose

> President Rose is the overseas-facing special site of Music Japan LLC, presenting President Rose — a five-year-old president who runs the front desk — and her AI receptionist, podcast, and short-form video services, in English.

## Pages

- [Home](https://president-rose-site.vercel.app/): Overview of President Rose and the front desk services (AI receptionist, podcast, shorts), with pricing teasers.
- [About](https://president-rose-site.vercel.app/about): About the President — why a five-year-old runs the front desk, and Meet the Cabinet.
- [Works](https://president-rose-site.vercel.app/works): Works & Services — AI Receptionist, short-form video, and podcast services, and how the front desk works.
- [Plans](https://president-rose-site.vercel.app/plans): Plans & Pricing — $9 Value Pack ($9, one-time, delivered in 24 hours, fully credited toward the Pilot), $49 Demo, $497 Pilot, and Full Front Desk ($1,497+ plus $497/mo).
- [Contact](https://president-rose-site.vercel.app/contact): Contact the Office — how to hire President Rose's front desk.

## Organization

- Music Japan LLC (official site): https://music-japan.com/en
